hotel.name: Waldorf Astoria Shanghai on the Bund

verified_facts.text: The Heritage Building is a landmark structure built in 1911 that was once the Shanghai Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Heritage Building is a landmark structure constructed in 1911. Once the legendary Shanghai Club

verified_facts.text: The heritage building was restored using archival photographs and historical records.
verified_facts.excerpt: this architectural gem has been lovingly restored using archival photographs and historical records

verified_facts.text: It was the first Waldorf Astoria hotel to open in Asia.
verified_facts.excerpt: As the first Waldorf Astoria hotel to open in Asia, our hotel is located on Shanghai’s iconic Bund

verified_facts.text: The hotel is one block from the Bund, with views of the Huangpu River.
verified_facts.excerpt: combines modern comfort with views of the Huangpu River. We're one block from the iconic Bund, featuring waterside strolls and shopping

verified_facts.text: The Long Bar has been restored to its original Shanghai Club grandeur.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unwind at the iconic 34-meter Long Bar, meticulously restored to its original Shanghai Club grandeur.

verified_facts.text: Pink Oyster at the Long Bar is an intimate eight-seat oyster omakase serving a ten-course degustation.
verified_facts.excerpt: Uncover Pink Oyster at the Long Bar, an intimate eight-seat oyster omakase. Savor an innovative ten-course degustation of fresh oysters paired with seasonal ingredients

verified_facts.text: Wai King Kok, on the fifth floor of the Waldorf Astoria Club, serves Cantonese and Chinese cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience the charm of old and new Shanghai on the fifth floor of the century-old Waldorf Astoria Club. Savor authentic Cantonese delicacies and refined Chinese cuisine

verified_facts.text: Ling Long serves modern Chinese cuisine by Chef Jason, and reservations are made by calling the restaurant directly.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor an innovative approach to modern Chinese cuisine by Chef Jason.

verified_facts.text: Peacock Alley serves afternoon tea and light dining and is inspired by Waldorf Astoria New York.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us at Peacock Alley for our famed afternoon tea and light dining. Inspired by Waldorf Astoria New York

verified_facts.text: Salon de Ville serves a Red Velvet Afternoon Tea with views across Pudong and the Bund.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in Salon de Ville with our famed Red Velvet Afternoon Tea, featuring signature cakes, premium teas, and champagne. Enjoy elegant sofa seating and sweeping views across Pudong and the Bund.

verified_facts.text: Grand Brasserie recreates a classic European brasserie and overlooks an interior courtyard garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover a chic yet casual dining experience recreating classic European brasseries. Overlooking a serene interior courtyard garden

verified_facts.text: The Waldorf Spa combines traditional Chinese practices with modern techniques, including couple and express therapies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our spa provides a serene sanctuary that combines traditional Chinese practices with modern techniques to soothe jet lag.

verified_facts.text: Hotel amenities include an indoor pool and a fitness center.

verified_facts.excerpt: Family Connecting Room Two Dbl Queen Dlx

verified_facts.text: Rooms have fine linens and a marble bathroom, with city views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wake up to breathtaking city views in spacious rooms and suites appointed with exclusive fine linens and an elegant marble bathroom.

verified_facts.text: Suites in the old building have colonial-style touches such as poster beds, walk-in closets and claw-foot tubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: In addition to opulent colonial-style suites (poster beds, walk-in closets, claw-foot tubs), the old building, now called the Waldorf Astoria Club

verified_facts.text: The hotel has over 3,000 square meters of event space for meetings, conferences and weddings.
verified_facts.excerpt: With over 3,000 square meters of elegant events space and a skilled events team
